Class Property

java.lang.Object
Property
Direct Known Subclasses:
EcoApartment, EcoGlamping, GreenResort, SustainableHouse
public abstract class Property extends Object
Represents a property with a name, calendar, and reservations. It allows managing reservations, pricing, and displaying property details.

      public double getBasePrice()

    • setName

      public void setName(String name)

    • setBasePrice

      public boolean setBasePrice(double newPrice)
      Sets a new price for all dates in the calendar. Cannot change price if there are existing reservations or if the new price is below 100.00.
      Parameters:
      newPrice - The new price to set for all dates.
      Returns:
      True if the price was successfully updated, false otherwise.

    • addReservation

      public boolean addReservation(Reservation reservation)
      Adds a reservation to the property's list of reservations.
      Parameters:
      reservation - The Reservation object to add.
      Returns:
      True if the reservation was successfully added, false otherwise.

    • removeReservation

      public void removeReservation(Reservation reservation)
      Removes a reservation from the property's list of reservations. Also updates the calendar to mark the dates as available.
      Parameters:
      reservation - The Reservation object to remove.
